description: Found 2026-07-31 during the credential-egress review. Both MCP export paths construct ResultExporter(anonymize=False) - benchbox/mcp/tools/benchmark.py:289 and analytics.py:346 - and benchmark.py returns the entire un-anonymized result payload to the MCP client (:428, :441), including platform.config (which schema.py:526 extracts with no secret filtering). Additionally, every MCP error response embeds details['exception_message'] = str(exception) verbatim (benchbox/mcp/errors.py:338, reached from e.g. benchmark.py:443-456), so a driver error carrying 'motherduck_token=...' or a DSN reaches the client and its logs; driven proof: json.dumps(make_execution_error('x', exception=Exception('motherduck_token=SENT-123'))) contains the sentinel. MCP has no tool argument for platform options, so credentials reach it only from env/saved config - but they do reach it. Decide deliberately per surface: local-analysis payloads may legitimately stay un-anonymized, but exception text must at minimum have secret-assignment patterns scrubbed.
